Sync tasks and quests with GitHub issues: push, status, labels

Mirror tasks, quests and their comments to GitHub issues. The repo comes from sync.github.repo in config or the git origin remote; the token from GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN or 'gh auth token'. Issues carry a woco marker so pushes are idempotent and never duplicate.

```sh
woco sync <subcommand> [flags]
```

Modifies project state. Supports `--dry-run`.

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
